verdict.rationale: Loops documents a no-code visual editor with an editor guide, and centralized brand settings for colors, type and spacing that every email picks up automatically. The founder describes SaaS lifecycle templates and an editor built on extended MJML, which implies cross-client rendering. Dynamic data variables are documented for transactional sends. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of correct rendering across email clients, detail on personalization tokens in marketing campaigns, and a documented reusable-template library or saved-template workflow.
